migrations.name: schema_migrations
migrations.rollback: transactional rollback before release; no destructive rollback after publish
migrations.forwardRepair: rerun the migration transaction

migrations.name: auth_workspaces
migrations.rollback: transactional rollback before release; retain tables after publish
migrations.forwardRepair: rerun migration and repair missing owner membership forward

migrations.name: project_graph
migrations.rollback: transactional rollback before release; retain graph tables after publish
migrations.forwardRepair: rerun migration and execute graph consistency audit

migrations.name: project_snapshot_scope
migrations.rollback: transactional rollback before release; restore from backup if data was written
migrations.forwardRepair: rerun migration and repair snapshot manifests forward

migrations.name: asset_governance
migrations.rollback: transactional rollback before release; do not drop asset tables
migrations.forwardRepair: rerun migration and run asset governance audit

migrations.name: workspace_storage_quota
migrations.rollback: transactional rollback before release
migrations.forwardRepair: rerun migration and forward-fill quota defaults

migrations.name: generation_tasks
migrations.rollback: transactional rollback before Worker publish
migrations.forwardRepair: rerun migration and rebuild queued outbox rows

migrations.name: provider_credentials
migrations.rollback: transactional rollback before credential writes; rotate if partial data exists
migrations.forwardRepair: rerun migration and re-encrypt forward without logging plaintext

migrations.name: task_commands
migrations.rollback: transactional rollback before command writes
migrations.forwardRepair: rerun migration and reconcile idempotent command rows

migrations.name: auth_devices
migrations.rollback: transactional rollback before device writes
migrations.forwardRepair: rerun migration and deduplicate devices forward

migrations.name: auth_device_legacy_dedup
migrations.rollback: no destructive rollback; restore backup if deduplication must be reversed
migrations.forwardRepair: rerun idempotent deduplication and preserve newest device record

migrations.name: task_queue_outbox
migrations.rollback: stop Worker Consumer before rollback; rebuild outbox forward
migrations.forwardRepair: insert missing queued outbox rows with stable dispatch keys

migrations.name: provider_submission_fencing
migrations.rollback: stop Worker claim/recovery before rollback; forward-repair attempts
migrations.forwardRepair: backfill submission keys and fence uncertain attempts

migrations.name: task_results_usage_ledger
migrations.rollback: no destructive rollback after usage writes; restore backup
migrations.forwardRepair: reconcile one ledger row per succeeded task

migrations.name: generation_task_events
migrations.rollback: transactional rollback before event trigger activation
migrations.forwardRepair: recreate trigger and backfill only from durable task state

migrations.name: migration_imports
migrations.rollback: stop migration workers before rollback; preserve staged objects
migrations.forwardRepair: rerun migration and expire/reconcile imports forward

migrations.name: migration_import_asset_uploads
migrations.rollback: stop migration uploads before rollback; retain staging objects for GC
migrations.forwardRepair: rerun migration and reconcile upload reservations forward

migrations.name: migration_import_commit
migrations.rollback: no destructive rollback after commit; restore backup and retry forward
migrations.forwardRepair: reconcile commit fingerprints and committed asset mappings

migrations.name: migration_exports
migrations.rollback: stop export worker before rollback; retain private archives for GC
migrations.forwardRepair: rerun migration and reconcile export state forward

migrations.name: migration_lifecycle_retry
migrations.rollback: transactional rollback before retry writes; old app ignores additive column
migrations.forwardRepair: rerun ALTER transaction and default retry_count to zero

migrations.name: custom_provider_profiles
migrations.rollback: transactional rollback before new provider writes; preserve encrypted credentials after publish
migrations.forwardRepair: rerun migration and backfill display_name/provider_type from provider_id

migrations.name: user_provider_credentials
migrations.rollback: transactional rollback before user-scoped credential writes; restore the encrypted database backup after publish
migrations.forwardRepair: repair duplicate creator/provider rows explicitly, rerun the migration, and rotate affected credentials without logging plaintext

migrations.name: user_numbers
migrations.rollback: transactional rollback before publishing user numbers; retain assigned numbers after publish
migrations.forwardRepair: assign only missing numbers above the current maximum and reset the sequence forward without reusing numbers

migrations.name: provider_website_urls
migrations.rollback: transactional rollback before website metadata writes; old applications ignore the additive nullable column
migrations.forwardRepair: backfill missing website URLs from known providers or the validated API origin and rerun constraint validation

migrations.name: admin_security_foundation
migrations.rollback: transactional rollback before administrator bootstrap; retain the isolated schema after any administrator is created
migrations.forwardRepair: rerun the idempotent migration, reapply role grants, and revoke administrator sessions if auth consistency is uncertain

migrations.name: site_configuration
migrations.rollback: transactional rollback before publishing site configuration; retain immutable revisions and uploaded brand objects after publish
migrations.forwardRepair: rerun the idempotent migration, reapply scoped role grants, and republish the last validated site revision

migrations.name: admin_usernames
migrations.rollback: transactional rollback before username login is enabled; keep internal email identities while reverting the application
migrations.forwardRepair: assign deterministic unique usernames to missing rows, validate lowercase format, and rerun the migration before enabling username login

migrations.name: admin_login_captcha
migrations.rollback: transactional rollback while CAPTCHA remains optional and disabled; retain account login as the compatibility path
migrations.forwardRepair: recreate the singleton setting, expire outstanding challenges, reapply Admin role grants, and keep CAPTCHA disabled until verification passes

migrations.name: remove_server_generation
migrations.rollback: restore the encrypted pre-contract backup and deploy the legacy application as one coordinated rollback; the dropped credential and task schema is not recreated in place
migrations.forwardRepair: stop legacy API and Worker processes, rerun the idempotent contract migration, remove any residual legacy database role grants, and redeploy only the browser-generation application
